headword: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}

definitions.gloss: made-to-order production, build-to-order, production on demand
definitions.explanation: A manufacturing system where products are made only after receiving a customer's order, rather than being mass-produced in advance. Contrasts with {見込|みこ}み{生産|せいさん} (speculative production / make-to-stock).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This factory operates on a made-to-order basis.

examples.japanese: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Since it's made to order, delivery takes two weeks.

examples.japanese: {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By adopting a build-to-order system, inventory risk can be reduced.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ (order) + ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (production). Also called {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}, which is perhaps slightly more formal. Common in manufacturing, business, and IT (e.g., Dell's build-to-order computer model).

The opposite concept is ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (make-to-stock), where goods are produced in advance based on demand forecasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧: made-to-order system
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make to order
- {注文生産|ちゅうもんせいさん}{品|ひん}: made-to-order products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受注生産|じゅちゅうせいさん}: production upon order receipt — essentially synonymous, slightly more formal
- ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: make-to-stock production — the opposite; producing in advance
- ⟦{量産|りょうさん}→量産：14441_ryousan⟧: mass production — large-scale production, typically not custom
